turnos.pregunta: How much extra is it if the old wallpaper has to come off?
consultas: How much extra is it if the old wallpaper has to come off?
turnos.respuesta:
Removal isn't something I can put a number on — it depends a lot on what's actually on the wall. Strippable modern paper can come off cleanly in full lengths; older layers, painted-over paper, or covering hung on unsealed drywall can be slow and sometimes take some of the surface with it, which turns into repair work nobody could see beforehand. That's why it's the hardest part of a job to price without looking at it.

The team quotes that directly once they've seen the walls. If you tell me roughly where the project is and what kind of space it is, I can get it in front of them.
